name: What is the difference between professional garage floor coating and a DIY kit?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between professional garage floor coating and a DIY kit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional garage floor coatings are much thicker, more durable, and better bonded than off-the-shelf DIY paint kits. Store-bought kits are usually thin water-based paints or light epoxies applied with simple acid etching, which frequently lift when hot vehicle tires sit on them. Professional installations use high-solids epoxy or polyurea formulas applied over mechanically diamond-ground concrete, creating a chemical and physical grip that resists abrasions, impact, and chemical spills. While DIY kits save money upfront, they often require complete grinding and redoing within one to three seasons when vehicle traffic strips the thin film.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional systems use industrial high-solids coatings over diamond-ground concrete, resisting hot-tire lift and chipping far better than thin DIY paint kits.
